item.title: China’s Spies Set Sights on A.I. Chips Years Before Nvidia Scandal
item.description: China’s espionage agency has been running a secret campaign to help the country’s companies acquire advanced A.I. chips and to gather intelligence on the sector, officials say.

item.title: Canada’s Boreal Forest Is Reshaped by Logging and Climate Change
